items.name: Agentic editing
items.description: An AI cube feeds a row of steps: cut silences, transitions, zooms and b-roll.

items.name: Rough cut
items.description: Silences, repetitions, mistakes and filler words light up on a raw recording, then the cut version drops in below.

items.name: Asset pipeline
items.description: Screenshots, stats and anything else wire into a Slack bot, then an assets folder, then the AI.

items.name: PDF to timeline
items.description: A PDF goes through extract and cut, and its photos land on a timeline at exact timestamps.

items.name: Saving a sound effect
items.description: A YouTube link drops through a Slack bot into a sounds folder, labelled with its type and name.

items.name: Prep work
items.description: Screenshots and memes gather into one folder, which the AI then places on the timeline.

items.name: Meme placement
items.description: A bar chart shows where the meme was asked for, where it was placed, and the peak it was timed to.

items.name: Ken Burns
items.description: A crop slowly tightens on a picture next to the scale-over-time curve that drives it.

items.name: Long form to short form
items.description: A moment of a landscape video becomes a vertical clip with captions.

items.name: Tella MCP
items.description: The AI talks to the Tella editor through the MCP, and a change appears in the editor.

items.name: B-roll pipeline
items.description: An uncut transcript becomes b-roll moments, a motion graphic, an MP4 and a b-roll layout in Tella.

items.name: One AI model
items.description: The AI in the middle, wired to the Tella MCP, ElevenLabs, CapCut and more tools.
